project.title: Café Management System
project.shortDescription: A Windows desktop application in C# .NET for order booking and billing.
project.description: Developed a Windows Forms café management system with admin and cashier modules for operational management.
features: Double-panel design: Cashier interface for order booking and Admin interface for settings.
Automated bill calculation, tax receipt printing, and daily summaries.
Inventory tracking triggering warnings on low stock levels.
